broadcast.description: Whether to broadcast out the mob's target to other mobs of the same type.

broadcast_range.description: Range in blocks for how far to broadcast.

min_radius.description: Minimum distance the target must be for the mob to run this goal.

within_radius_event.description: Event to run when target is within the radius. This event is broadcasted if broadcast is true.

description: The mob freezes and looks at the mob they are targeting.
